name: IRON
summary: A humanoid from Chinese EV maker XPeng, first shown in 2024 working on its own car assembly line and running the company's automotive-derived 'Turing' AI chips. A 2025 revision added a humanlike spine, solid-state battery and a soft outer covering, and XPeng has said it intends to mass-produce the robot.
notable: Developed and trialed inside a carmaker's own factory
Shares AI silicon with XPeng's self-driving stack
